name: Hainan Haiyao Co., Ltd.
summary: Hainan Haiyao Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products and medical devices in China and internationally. The company offers big health, digestive, anti-infective, respiratory, anti-tumor, vitamins, and chronic disease category products. It also provides active pharmaceutical ingredients and intermediates; traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces; medical devices, including disposable medical mask, implant, and source processor; and medical services. In addition, the company offers chemical drugs, modern traditional Chinese medicine, biopharmaceuticals, and cell immunotherapy. Hainan Haiyao Co., Ltd. was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Haikou, China.
